steps.en: Clone the template as your game's repo and start Claude Code at its root
steps.zh: 把模板克隆成游戏仓库，在根目录启动 Claude Code

steps.en: Describe the game you want in one line
steps.zh: 用一句话描述想要的游戏

steps.en: Asks one round of genre questions and writes a one-page brief
steps.zh: 按题材问一轮问题，写出一页游戏简报

steps.en: Read the brief and say Build it, or change a line first
steps.zh: 读简报，说开做，或先改其中一行

steps.en: Builds a browser game, replays scripted keys headless and marks each brief line
steps.zh: 写出浏览器游戏，无头回放按键，逐行标注简报

value.en: A playable browser game checked against your brief, without writing the design doc or code yourself
value.zh: 拿到一个对照简报检查过的可玩浏览器游戏，不用自己写设计文档和代码
